description: Defines the PastOrderList class for the Point of Sale module in ERPNext, managing the display and interaction of past orders including filtering, searching, and rendering invoice data.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.PastOrderList
classes.description: Class managing the past order list component in the POS interface, including UI setup, event binding, and data fetching.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PastOrderList with wrapper and events, then sets up the component.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Initializes the component by preparing DOM, creating filters, and binding events.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Creates the HTML structure for the past order list and caches DOM elements.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds input and click events for search, filter, and invoice interactions.

methods.name: make_filter_section
methods.description: Creates search and status filter controls and sets default values.

methods.name: refresh_list
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of past orders based on current filters.

methods.name: get_invoice_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single invoice entry.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the component and refreshes the list if shown.
